hypotheses.Q0_exact_factorization: QK1/QK2/value writes and finite Shapley effects recompose with relative error below 2e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_layer0_is_single_source_transport: At Layer 0, at least 90% of the final attention delta projects through the edited source position in every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_layer1_recruits_earlier_context: At Layer 1, sources before the edited token receive at least 10% absolute projection in every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_layer0_value_path_dominates: The value factor receives at least 50% of the full final-MLP write projection at Layer 0 in every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_layer1_routing_is_material: QK1 plus QK2 receive at least 25% of the full final-MLP write projection at Layer 1 in every corpus.
hypotheses.Q5_three_state_selected_heads_are_suffic: The top three heads by target projection recover at least 60% of the final attention delta in every cell.
hypotheses.Q6_state_selection_beats_static_capacity: Top-three target-projection heads beat top-three static tensor-capacity heads by at least 0.10 attention fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.Q7_static_capacity_is_not_a_usage_map: Median Spearman correlation between static tensor capacity and realized head importance is below 0.50 in every cell.
hypotheses.Q8_no_single_QKOV_factor_is_sufficient: No single QKOV factor reaches 0.90 full-write fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.Q9_factor_ordering_transfers_ood: The ordering of median QK1/QK2/value full-write projections matches between FineWeb and TinyStories at each layer.
